content.text: Fixed. The bug was in `mustSegregate` (`src/cargo/hazmat.ts:17-21`): it normalized both classes with `primaryClass`, which strips the division (e.g. `"5.1"` → `"5"`), but the segregation table is keyed by the full class including division (`"5.1"`, `"2.1"`, `"4.1"`, `"5.2"`). So any lookup for a divided class missed the table entirely and returned no conflict. I changed the lookup to use the trimmed full class string instead, and added a regression test covering the incident's acceptance criteria. All 27 tests pass.
